name: Holy Quran
longDescription: Study the Holy Quran, its translation, interpretation (Tafsir), recitation (Qira'at), memorization (Hifz), and the science of Tajweed. Discover the miraculous nature of the Quran and its guidance for all aspects of life.

name: Dhikr & Duas
longDescription: Collection of authentic dhikr (remembrance of Allah) and duas (supplications) from the Quran and Sunnah. Learn the importance of constant remembrance of Allah and various supplications for different occasions and times.

name: Morning & Evening
longDescription: Essential remembrances (adhkar) to recite in the morning and evening. These authentic supplications from the Quran and Sunnah provide protection, blessings, and spiritual strength throughout the day and night.

name: Prayer
longDescription: Comprehensive collection of supplications for prayer including ablution, entering the mosque, athan, during prayer positions, tashahhud, after salam, and Qunoot Al-Witr.

name: Home & Daily
longDescription: Supplications for everyday activities including entering and leaving home, wearing clothes, using the restroom, and other daily routines.

name: Food & Drink
longDescription: Authentic supplications to recite before eating, after meals, when breaking fast, and visiting others for food. Express gratitude to Allah for His provisions.

name: Travel
longDescription: Essential supplications for travelers including starting a journey, mounting transport, entering towns, and returning home safely.

name: Protection
longDescription: Powerful duas for seeking Allah's protection from evil, the devil, evil eye, fear, enemies, and harmful situations.

name: Distress & Anxiety
longDescription: Powerful duas for times of distress, anxiety, sorrow, debt, and difficult situations. Find peace through these blessed supplications.

name: Health & Sickness
longDescription: Supplications for visiting the sick, seeking cure, dealing with pain, and praying for recovery through the remembrance of Allah.

name: Social & Etiquette
longDescription: Supplications for social occasions including greeting others, receiving gifts, attending gatherings, and showing gratitude.

name: Death & Funeral
longDescription: Supplications related to death, funeral prayers, visiting graves, offering condolences, and praying for the deceased.

name: Weather & Nature
longDescription: Supplications during rain, thunder, wind, seeing the crescent moon, and connecting with Allah through His creation.

name: Hajj & Umrah
longDescription: Essential duas for Hajj and Umrah including Talbiyah, at Safa and Marwah, on Arafah, and at the Black Stone.

name: Forgiveness & Repentance
longDescription: Duas for seeking forgiveness (Istighfar), repentance (Tawbah), and experiencing Allah's infinite mercy.

name: Guidance & Faith
longDescription: Supplications for seeking guidance including Istikhara, dealing with doubt, and strengthening faith.

name: Remembrance & Dhikr
longDescription: Beautiful forms of dhikr including Tasbeeh, sending prayers upon the Prophet, and the excellence of remembering Allah.

name: Family & Marriage
longDescription: Supplications for newlyweds, wedding night, protecting children, and building a blessed family life.

name: Sacrifice & Worship
longDescription: Supplications when slaughtering or offering a sacrifice, following the Sunnah of Prophet Ibrahim.
